case.pattern_description: In-person transaction reported as unauthorized by the customer. Validation confirmed the customer was not in the geographic vicinity of the merchant at the time of the transaction, suggesting a cloned card.

evidence.claim: Transaction was conducted in-person with a risk score of 0.48.
Customer confirmed they were in a different region (addr1: 450) compared to the transaction location (addr1: 126).

case.summary: Customer C02354 reported an unauthorized $39.08 in-person transaction. While the initial risk score was moderate (0.48), step-up validation confirmed the customer was in a different geographic region at the time of the transaction. The card is suspected to have been cloned and used for an out-of-region purchase.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they have the physical card in their possession but were at their home address (addr1: 450) during the time of the transaction in addr1: 126.

final.reason: Confirmed fraud via customer validation and location mismatch.

next_best_actions.what_changed: The status moved from suspicious to confirmed fraud after customer validation confirmed a geographic impossibility for an in-person transaction.

sar.reason: Confirmed unauthorized use of payment card via suspected cloning.
sar.narrative: On 2016-11-27, customer C02354 reported an unauthorized in-person transaction (ID: 3491361) for $39.08. The transaction occurred at a merchant location associated with addr1: 126. Upon investigation and direct communication with the customer, it was determined that the customer was physically present in a different region (addr1: 450) at the time of the transaction and remained in possession of their physical debit card (C02354-K2). This discrepancy strongly indicates that the card details were compromised and a cloned card was used at a physical point of sale. The bank has blocked the card to prevent further loss and is filing this report due to the confirmed fraudulent nature of the activity.

stop_reason: Fraud confirmed via customer validation of location mismatch.
